title: Beast Cave
concept_line: Zwift is the companion. Kona is the destination.

principles: Lava is action, selection and progress.
Room identity comes from atmosphere and content, never replacement global chrome.
Photography and authored 3D create place and emotion.

lighting.training: cool screen spill plus narrow orange cove light

zones.name: The Threshold
zones.purpose: Slow reveal into the room from a rough basalt portal.

zones.name: The Machine
zones.purpose: Primary indoor-bike and Zwift flow-state area.

zones.name: The Science Lab
zones.purpose: Large ride display, compact secondary data display, workout notes and controlled-environment cues.

zones.name: Heat Protocol
zones.purpose: Fans, towels, bottles and environmental-control storytelling.

zones.name: Gear Wall
zones.purpose: Bike, helmet, shoes, race kit, bibs, medals and race-prep objects.

zones.name: Reset
zones.purpose: Low sofa, mat, roller, dumbbells and quieter post-session corner.

zones.name: Kona Horizon
zones.purpose: A framed ocean-and-lava horizon that keeps Kona visually present from the trainer.

interaction_hotspots.copy: Indoor training as controlled work: repeatable intervals, environment and data.
Current-generation Speedmax reference hook. Do not claim athlete-specific component configuration without a sourced manifest.
Everything in the room points toward Kona.

evidence.claim: Sanders is a prominent advocate of indoor training and has described the controlled indoor environment as a way to turn training into a science lab for heat adaptation and data-driven progression.
Sanders publicly introduced the new Canyon Speedmax in July 2026 after testing and fitting work with Canyon.
Canyon launched the new Speedmax platform in July 2026 with revised geometry, integrated hydration/storage and expanded adjustability.
Zwift supports structured workouts, virtual worlds, community rides and smart-trainer integration.

asset_policy.likeness_slot: optional external media hook; disabled by default
asset_policy.bike_asset: reuse an existing repo Speedmax or neutral triathlon-bike GLB only after exact provenance is verified
asset_policy.logos: use text/shape treatment in the production candidate; official partner marks require explicit approval before public wiring

mobile_strategy: baked/emissive screen light rather than many dynamic point lights

acceptance: No import from production navigation, hall or world registry.
Full-room overview reads clearly on entry.
Trainer area is the visual hero but room remains explorable.
At least seven spatially distinct zones.
No unsupported athlete quote is rendered.
No claim of sponsorship, endorsement or official partnership.
Mobile lite mode preserves layout and interaction targets.
